Virgin Trains granted access for London-Europe rail service

Virgin Trains has received approval for track access through the Channel Tunnel, enabling it to launch a high-speed rail service between London and European cities. The service aims to rival Eurostar, which has held a monopoly on passenger services through the tunnel since 1994. Virgin plans to operate up to 20 trains daily, with services expected to commence in 2030. This development follows the granting of a green light for the company to operate these international routes.
